rs-ppbat.label: IPL players who were elite powerplay hitters, 2024–2026
rs-ppbat.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
rs-ppbat.filters: Min. 100 balls in the phase; elite = 15% better than the phase average
rs-ppbat.query: WITH p AS (SELECT d.batter_id pid, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY d.batter_id), lg AS (SELECT SUM(runs) * 1.0 / SUM(balls) avg FROM p) SELECT COUNT(*) qualified, SUM(CASE WHEN runs * 1.0 / balls > (SELECT avg FROM lg) * 1.15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) elite FROM p WHERE balls >= 100

rs-ppbowl.label: IPL players who were elite new-ball bowlers, 2024–2026
rs-ppbowl.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
rs-ppbowl.filters: Min. 100 balls in the phase; elite = 15% better than the phase average
rs-ppbowl.query: WITH p AS (SELECT d.bowler_id pid, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY d.bowler_id), lg AS (SELECT SUM(runs) * 1.0 / SUM(balls) avg FROM p) SELECT COUNT(*) qualified, SUM(CASE WHEN runs * 1.0 / balls < (SELECT avg FROM lg) * 0.88 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) elite FROM p WHERE balls >= 100
